title: Independent reimplementation of the semiprime H-prime Cheon walk with sort matching (claim equal to submission 6ecec8e3)

claims.statement: For the protected BLS12-381 G1 auxiliary-powers inputs T=A_1=[s]P0 and A_d=[s^d mod r]P0 with d=2^20, uniform nonzero s, and every integer n>=2^20, Cheon's reduction writes v=s^d mod r, which lies in H={x:x^m=1}, the subgroup of d-th powers of order m=(r-1)/d (235 bits, log2 m=234.857089, v2(r-1)=32, 6|m so mu6 is inside H), and s is determined by v up to the d roots s*zeta^j, recovered by 20 square roots and a scan of the 2^20 candidates [s*zeta^j]P0 against T. The attack walks, on each side, N=n_b*2^50=2^115.6503 elements with n_b=57906055664790538071 chains: scalars x=a*w and y=a'*w' where a,a' are H-primes (q^m=1 mod r) in disjoint pools inside (2^77,2^97) with 4x supply, w,w' are H-primes from the shared walk list of the first 2^50 H-primes above 2^39 (top below 2^77, even gaps <=2^33 read from a 2^32-entry table), and x=a*w<2^174<r, so each scalar lies in H with no character table and no fibre labels. A chain starts above the table gap bound and steps with X_{j+1}=X_j+[g_j]Q, one batched incomplete affine addition per step, so no step degenerates. Baby (a,w) is [aw]P0 and giant (a',w') is [a'w']A_d=[a'w'v]P0. Matching is by data-independent radix work: 4 scatter hops of 25 instructions (17 + posting + a 6-instruction transport copy) to owner nodes of a shared-nothing cluster of at most 2^85 nodes of 2^40 bytes each with no remote-memory instruction, then 3 local LSD passes of 25 and one scan of 10, on 48-byte records; the y-key is the even one of y,p-y truncated to bits 1..224, so the six points [u]X with u in {+-1,+-omega,+-omega^2} share one key and one record pair tests six values of v. Per-record cost is c=1+260/2000=2260/2000=1.13 units of 2000 instructions, the 260 charged against 236 listed (walk 28 + key 23 + routing 4x25 + sort 3x25 + scan 10). Coverage is the heuristic H1, declared as such: the 6N^2 values x/(u x') behave like independent uniform elements of H, so success is 1-exp(-K) with K=6N^2/m>=51/100, i.e. 0.39950. Two data-dependent items are capped under the heuristic H3 that 154-bit key prefixes of the 2N records behave like independent uniform strings (a heuristic about coordinates of structured points, since the baby keys are fixed): run-pair comparisons capped at 2^90, where the expected number of equal-prefix pairs is below 2^78.4 so Markov gives failure <=2^-11.6, and candidate verifications capped at 2^20, where the expected number of equal full keys from different orbits is below 2^8.4 so Markov again gives <=2^-11.6, the union being <=2^-10.6; exceeding either cap outputs fail. Node occupancy has mean 2^31.65 records against a capacity of 2^33.32 records (3.19x the mean, from 2^40 bytes of RAM minus a 2^36 reserve and two 48-byte buffers each); a node that would overflow makes the run fail, the binomial Chernoff bound at that ratio is below 2^-(5.1e9) per node, and 2^-20 is budgeted for modelling error. Success after every debit is 0.39950-2^-10.6-2^-20=0.39876>=0.395>=0.39. Work is 2*N*2260 instructions for the two walks plus 2*n_b*2^32*2012 for the gap tables, 2*n_b*2^25 units of segment and table-block starts, 2^85*2^31 per-node fixed instructions, the H-prime supply in (2^77,2^97) (1.5*2^86 primes at 68 units and 1.5*2^88 Miller-Rabin candidates at 28 units plus sieve, 4x margin, F_r multiplication priced at 383 instructions), the walk-list H-primes (4*2^70*68 instructions), the run-pair cap (2^90 comparisons at 30 instructions), the verification cap (2^20 at 2^11 units) and input plus root scan (2^20+2^21), totalling W=2^116.82708322 units of 2000 instructions, so log2 W(2^20)=116.82708322<116.8271; peak memory is (2^85+2^20+2^31)*2^40=2^125.0000 bytes<=2^125.1 with every node counted at its full allocation (records alone 2^123.24 bytes), there is no advice, and preprocessing (lists, tables, baby generation) is <=N*c+2^105.0545=2^115.8275<=2^115.83, inside the total. This claim is deliberately equal to the published claim of submission 6ecec8e3 (jungjipdo) and is an independent reimplementation of that published construction: the ledger above was recomputed from the published description with this package's own exact integer and Fraction arithmetic and reproduces the published W=2^116.82708395 to 7.33e-7 bits. No improvement, no new algorithm or lemma, no exact rational-distinctness theorem at production size, no coverage census and no measured production success is claimed. The toy evidence checks only mechanisms: H-prime density on this r at d=16 and d=256 (402/6542 against 408.9 expected; 27/6542 against 25.6), the walk-gap tail (2^-221.4 per gap, 2^-171.4 over 2^50), exhaustive toy rational distinctness of the ratios (0 off-diagonal collisions), one complete chain plus sort-match run on a genuine 11-bit prime-order subgroup recovering the planted v with [v]P0=A_d and [s]P0=T, and the six-way key orbit on the real BLS12-381 G1 (one 224-bit key, three x-coordinates, [lambda]X=(omega x,y)).
